text:
tom_finance: Heads-up: Tomorrow were enabling a streamlined approval for recurring SaaS under $5k/year in the procurement portal. This should speed approvals for small tools. See the portal guide for the checklist.
anya_sales: Awesome. Does this apply retroactively to current subscriptions on company cards?
chet_engineering: Also, who owns the vendor record if multiple teams use the same tool?
tom_finance: Retro: not automatic. Please migrate existing subs to the portal so they become eligible. Owner: pick a single owner per vendor (team lead or tool admin) when you create the record; the portal will require that field.
procure-bot: New workflow live: "SaaS recurring < $5K". Auto-verify vendor, attach T&C snapshot, and issue single-use virtual card when requested. Missing #project or #cost-center tags = fallback to manual review.
anya_sales: What about multi-year pricing or termination fees?
tom_finance: Multi-year deals that average >$5k/year still need manual review. Termination fees or unusual clauses route to legal. If unsure, select "pre-approval" so procurement can triage.
chet_engineering: Cool. We'll start migrating tools this week and set expected seat growth. Thanks.
tom_finance: Thanks all  well run a short audit two weeks after launch and follow up if anything looks off.
